description: Implementation of a mutable, in-memory message source for localization, which stores PresentationMessages indexed by locale and code, allowing addition, removal, merging, and retrieval of messages.

classes.name: CachedMessageSource
classes.description: In-memory implementation of MutableMessageSource backed by a map of locales to PresentationMessageMaps, supporting message addition, removal, merging, and retrieval based on locale and message code.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds a PresentationMessage to the in-memory store, associating it with its locale and code.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns a collection of all locales present in the message store.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Retrieves all PresentationMessages stored in the message source.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a specified PresentationMessage from the store based on its locale and code.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges messages from another MutableMessageSource into the current one, optionally overwriting existing messages.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a PresentationMessage by its key and locale.

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Returns all PresentationMessages for a specific locale.

methods.name: resolveCode
methods.description: Resolves a message code and locale into a MessageFormat object, used for message formatting.
